set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=bfebcc94cb7e50786bd8287682b1082cc66001f4; PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101; git fetch --quiet origin main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; test -e "$PORT"; . ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null; echo '=== BUILD ==='; idf.py build; echo '=== PORT BEFORE FLASH ==='; ls -l "$PORT"; echo '=== FLASH (NO ERASE) ==='; idf.py -p "$PORT" flash; echo '=== WAIT FOR SAME PORT ==='; for i in $(seq 1 30); do [ -e "$PORT" ] && break; sleep 1; done; test -e "$PORT"; echo '=== SERIAL MONITOR 120S ==='; python - <<'PY'
import serial, time
port='/dev/cu.usbmodem1101'
end=time.monotonic()+120
with serial.Serial(port,115200,timeout=0.20,write_timeout=1) as s:
    try:
        s.dtr=False
        s.rts=False
    except Exception:
        pass
    start=time.monotonic()
    sent_help=False
    sent_permit=False
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
        if not sent_help and elapsed>=3:
            s.write(b'help\n'); s.flush(); print('>>> SENT: help', flush=True); sent_help=True
        if not sent_permit and elapsed>=6:
            s.write(b'permit 180\n'); s.flush(); print('>>> SENT: permit 180', flush=True); sent_permit=True
        data=s.readline()
        if data:
            print(data.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip(), flush=True)
PY
